records.label: spacr.qt.job_runner#3
records.source: ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted **on the worker thread**. A closure connected to it is invoked there. Touching a widget from it is undefined behaviour. The only safe thing a slot on that signal may do is re-emit a ``Signal`` whose receiver is a bound method of a GUI-thread object -- Qt then queues the call onto the GUI thread.
records.context: ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted **on the background execution unit**. A closure connected to it is invoked there. Touching a widget from it is undefined behaviour. The only safe thing a slot on that signal may do is re-emit a ``Signal`` whose receiver is a bound method of a main GUI execution path object -- Qt then schedules the call onto the main GUI execution path.

Að vinna með viðmótshlut þaðan hefur óskilgreinda hegðun. Eina örugga aðgerðin sem afgreiðslufall (slot) á þessu merki má framkvæma er að senda aftur ``Signal`` þar sem viðtakandinn er bundin aðferð hlutar á GUI-þræðinum. Qt setur þá kallið í biðröð til keyrslu á GUI-þræðinum.
